correctness.rationale: The exact componentwise formulas give the physical residual gain, with positive interior maximum and vanishing endpoint limits. At z=K³t the high-mode contribution divided by K is bounded by z/(1+z)², and the low contribution is uniformly at most 1/K. The lower test z=1 and strict limiting maximum prove the constant and maximizing scale. The DR comparison is a specialization of the published Cauchy-cycle formula.
